$comment: Model and effort policy per agent. Reasoning-heavy roles get opus; mechanical and high-volume roles get sonnet or haiku. Override per team, not per call, and only with a reason you can state.

gh-orchestrator.why: Coordination and gate decisions across every team

gh-advisor.why: Ranking by unblocking value requires holding the whole state at once

stack-manager.why: Stack topology errors are expensive and hard to reverse

conflict-resolver.why: Reconciling two intents is genuine reasoning, not pattern matching

adversarial-verifier.why: Refutation is harder than detection and carries the board's precision

ci-triage-analyst.why: Misclassifying a failure sends the whole loop the wrong way

release-conductor.why: Version and gate mistakes are unrecoverable once published

docs-reviewer.why: High volume, mechanical comparison against the diff

merge-marshal.why: Gate checking is deterministic — a checklist against live state

agent-delegator.why: Judging delegability wrong wastes a whole agent run and returns an unverifiable PR

escalation.$comment: When a role repeatedly fails at its assigned tier, escalate rather than retrying at the same tier.
